name: Ichor Elixir
oracle_text:
If you would roll one or more planar dice, instead roll that many planar dice plus one and ignore one.
{T}: Add {C}{C}.
blocked_sentences: If you would roll one or more planar dice, instead roll that many planar dice plus one and ignore one.

needs.what: the Planechase subsystem (rule 901) with planar die rolls (901.9, 706): a roll-the-planar-die special action and event, plus a player-wide replacement static that rolls N+1 planar dice instead of N and lets the roller ignore one result
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Nothing in the reference knows planar dice, planes or a planar deck: no op rolls a planar die, no trigger event or replacement static intercepts a die roll, and the existing replace_* statics (replace_draw, replace_damage, replace_life_gain, replace_counters, replace_token_creation) each replace a different event. The {T}: Add {C}{C} line is already expressible as the starting_point's mana ability; only the replacement line is blocked
